body.systemPrompt: You are scanning a watchlist for an investment operations team. Report the most recent corporate action announced for Bank of America Floating Rate Senior Notes due September 2027, CUSIP 06051GLX5, either by the issuer itself or in an official exchange or SEC notice: a reverse or forward stock split, a CUSIP or ticker change, a name change, an ADS ratio change, or a redemption, tender offer or exchange offer for this security. Ignore every other company and every other security. Ignore earnings, dividends, buybacks, share offerings, lawsuits, law-firm advertisements and analyst commentary. If no such action appears in the sources, write none found for event_type and not stated for every other field. Copy dates and times exactly as the source writes them. Write not stated for any field the source does not give. Never infer.

identifier_in_source.description: Ticker or CUSIP of the affected security exactly as the source prints it, or not stated

event_type.description: One of: reverse split, forward split, CUSIP change, ticker change, name change, ADS ratio change, redemption, tender offer, exchange offer, other, none found

terms.description: Split ratio, or redemption price and amount, as stated

effective_as_stated.description: Effective date and time exactly as the source writes it

effective_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the first trading day on the new terms for a split, or the redemption date for a bond, or not stated

new_identifier.description: New CUSIP or new ticker as stated, or not stated

source_notice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD printed on the notice itself

CHARLOTTE, N.C., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bank of America Corporation announced today that it will redeem on September 15, 2026 all $500,000,000 principal amount outstanding of its Floating Rate Senior Notes, due September 2027 (CUSIP No. 06051GLX5) (the "Floating Rate Notes"), and all $1,500,000,000 principal amount outstanding of its 5.933% Fixed/Floating Rate Senior Notes, due September 2027 (CUSIP No. 06051GLV9) (the "Fixed/Floating Rate Notes" and, together with the Floating Rate Notes, the "Notes").

The redemption price for each series of the Notes will be equal to 100% of the principal amount of such series, plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date of September 15, 2026. Interest on each series of the Notes will cease to accrue on the redemption date.
